data: What is the name of the edge connecting node n1,1 and node n2,1?

The question asks for the name of the edge connecting node n1,1 and node n2,1. From the caption, we can see that the nodes are labeled with coordinates in the format nX,Y, where X and Y are integers representing their positions on the grid. The edges connecting these nodes are labeled with eXX.YY, where XX and YY are the coordinates of the starting and ending nodes of the edge. 

To find the edge connecting n1,1 and n2,1, we look at the edge that starts at n1,1 and ends at n2,1. This edge is labeled as e11.21. Therefore, the name of the edge connecting node n1,1 and node n2,1 is e11.21.
